\newcommand{\MatchDiscussion}{M1 reaches the goal plane in 4 of five cases; M2 reaches the goal plane in 3 of five cases; M3 reaches the goal plane in 3 of five cases; M4 reaches the goal plane in 4 of five cases. M1 gives the largest number of goal-plane predictions in these five recorded flights. The table reports each reached-case mean together with its contributing count. Large force corrections and iteration-limit cases reveal a strong dependence on the early recorded motion. Fit failures denote numerical iteration limits; their candidate trajectories are retained in the calculation records.}

\newcommand{\TorqueDisplacement}{0.039}
\newcommand{\TorqueResults}{The damped goal-plane centre is $(2.654,1.949)$ m, compared with $(2.616,1.953)$ m at constant spin. The displacement is 0.039 m, or 0.35\% of the 11 m flight distance. Spin decreases by 14.36\%, and the goal-crossing time changes by +0.07\%. Adding the much weaker viscous term changes the damped crossing by 1.5e-05 m. Thus this reference torque has a visible effect on spin and a smaller, measurable effect on the short-flight endpoint.}
